## OpenAI Overview

**Type**: AI Research Organization
**Founded**: 2015
**Location**: San Francisco

**Key Products**:
- GPT Series (GPT-3, GPT-4, GPT-4 Turbo)
- ChatGPT (conversational assistant)
- API Platform for developers
- DALL-E (image generation)

**Business Model**: Capped-profit, Microsoft partnership for cloud

**User Relevance**: Frequently uses OpenAI APIs for agent development
